tnk.ponder.tag.resources.description: Generators, metal yields and material recycling.
tnk.ponder.tag.electronics.description: Reusable tooling, processor manufacture and item networks.
tnk.ponder.tag.arcane.description: Source, liquid Mana, spell Scrolls and rituals.
tnk.ponder.tag.eclipse.description: Ink, Radiance, Shadow materials and final assemblies.
tnk.ponder.tag.workshops.description: Engineering structures, farming, cooking and specialised machines.
tnk.ponder.tag.workshop.description: Construction tools, cages, mirrors, projectors and shared boards.
tnk.ponder.certus_dust.step_1: Crushing one Certus Quartz Crystal produces two Certus Quartz Dust. Feed the dust into the Growth Laser.
tnk.ponder.certus_seed.step_1: Fit a Growth Lens and supply at least 16 RPM. Watch one Certus Quartz Dust become a Small Certus Quartz Bud.
tnk.ponder.certus_seed.step_2: Move the bud on a belt. Keep it as an item for the Water-spouting stages; placing it in the world is a different growth route.
tnk.ponder.certus_seed.header: Certus Quartz: dust to a small bud
tnk.ponder.certus_growth.step_1: Stage 1/3: three separate 100 mB Water operations grow Small Certus Quartz Bud into Medium Certus Quartz Bud. The item stays on the belt between adjacent Spouts.
tnk.ponder.certus_growth_02.step_1: Stage 2/3: three separate 100 mB Water operations grow Medium Certus Quartz Bud into Large Certus Quartz Bud. The item stays on the belt between adjacent Spouts.
tnk.ponder.certus_growth_03.step_1: Stage 3/3: three separate 100 mB Water operations grow Large Certus Quartz Bud into Certus Quartz Cluster. The item stays on the belt between adjacent Spouts.
tnk.ponder.certus_recycling.step_1: One Cluster gives two guaranteed Crystals, plus two independent 50% extra rolls.
tnk.ponder.certus_recycling_02.step_1: Recycle one Crystal into two Dust. XP is an occasional byproduct.
tnk.ponder.certus_recycling_03.step_1: Return one Certus Quartz Dust to the Growth Laser. Export the spare dust and crystals.
tnk.ponder.chute_generator.step_1: The ordinary Create Chute sits directly below the generated block.
tnk.ponder.chute_generator.step_2: Set the Water source back from the contact point. A one-block drop trench makes the Water fall before it can enter the generation cell.
tnk.ponder.chute_generator.step_3: Put the retained Veridium catalyst directly below the separate Lava source.
tnk.ponder.chute_generator.step_4: Lava flows towards the falling Water and makes Veridium over the Chute. The Drill mines that block; neither source is mined.
tnk.ponder.stone_catalysts.step_1: Andesite produces Andesite. The catalyst is retained.
tnk.ponder.stone_catalysts.step_2: Veridium, Ochrum, Asurine and Crimsite each select their matching metal-bearing stone.
tnk.ponder.stone_catalysts.step_3: Scoria, Diorite and Limestone use the same two-layer layout.
tnk.ponder.resin_compressor.step_1: A Sapper extracts Resin from a supported tree. Pipe it into the Compressor.
tnk.ponder.resin_compressor_02.step_1: The Compressor consumes 500 mB Resin for each Raw Rubber.
tnk.ponder.resin_compressor_03.step_1: A lit Campfire below the Compressor supplies its required passive heat.
tnk.ponder.rubber_curing.step_1: Send fan airflow through a lit Campfire onto the Raw Rubber.
tnk.ponder.rubber_curing.step_2: Cured Rubber is the common rubber ingredient used by the pack.
tnk.ponder.rubber_curing_02.step_1: Feed it to the Sealed Mechanism Deployer. The rubber is consumed.
tnk.ponder.rotation_mechanism.step_1: Start with a wooden slab and apply the first Andesite Alloy.
tnk.ponder.rotation_mechanism.step_2: Apply the second Alloy to the same workpiece.
tnk.ponder.rotation_mechanism.step_3: The Diesel Generators Hammer finishes the mechanism and loses one durability. It stays in the Deployer.
tnk.ponder.rotation_mechanism.header: Rotation assembly and a reusable hammer
tnk.ponder.ie_pressing_rolling.step_1: Mechanical Presses make the plates previously made by the IE Metal Press.
tnk.ponder.ie_pressing_rolling_02.step_1: Roll an Electrum Sheet into two Electrum Wires. Copper Sheets follow the same process.
tnk.ponder.ie_pressing_rolling_03.step_1: Prepared rod stock uses a Deployer with the retained Rod Mold.
tnk.ponder.ie_saw_variants.step_1: The first cutting operation strips the log.
tnk.ponder.ie_saw_variants_02.step_1: Process the stripped log again to obtain planks and the applicable sawdust.
tnk.ponder.ie_saw_variants_03.step_1: A filtered Saw selects compatible final shapes. Set the desired result filter.
tnk.ponder.ie_bottling.step_1: A single item and a small fluid dose can use a Spout.
tnk.ponder.ie_bottling_02.step_1: Basin recipes handle compatible multi-item or fluid-only batches.
tnk.ponder.ie_bottling_03.step_1: Collect returned containers and fluids on their own output lanes.
tnk.ponder.metal_two_four.step_1: Crushing Wheels turn one Raw Iron into two Crushed Iron.
tnk.ponder.metal_two_four_02.step_1: Each Crushed Iron gives two Dust in the IE Crusher.
tnk.ponder.metal_two_four_03.step_1: Two Crusher operations give four Dust. Cooking them gives four Ingots.
tnk.ponder.metal_five.step_1: Keep the four Dust from the industrial line together as one recipe quantity.
tnk.ponder.metal_five.step_2: An Eclipse Lens converts four Dust into five Ingots.
tnk.ponder.metal_five.step_3: Export the Ingots. The supported metals share this same 2x, 4x, 5x progression.
tnk.ponder.aluminium_nickel.step_1: Soul Fire fan processing haunts Obsidian into Crying Obsidian.
tnk.ponder.aluminium_nickel_02.step_1: The IE Crusher produces Aluminium Dust and Nickel Dust.
tnk.ponder.aluminium_nickel_03.step_1: Separate both dust outputs and cook them. Ordinary mining remains a valid way to start.
tnk.ponder.wart_silver.step_1: Crush Nether Wart into Cinder Flour.
tnk.ponder.wart_silver_02.step_1: A retained Convergence Lens transforms Cinder Flour into Silver Dust.
tnk.ponder.wart_silver_03.step_1: Cook the dust. Silver and Gold can then be heated together for Electrum.
tnk.ponder.arcane_essence.step_1: Make Wardstone Blend from Twisting Vines and Sourceberry Bush, then haunt it into Lapis.
tnk.ponder.arcane_essence_02.step_1: Superheat one Lapis, one Amethyst Shard and one XP Nugget into one Arcane Essence.
tnk.ponder.arcane_essence_02.step_2: Feed the XP Nuggets from your processing lines. Their drops are a chance, so keep a buffer.
tnk.ponder.mana_tubes.step_1: Mix one Essence with 250 mB Water to make 250 mB Mana. No heat is needed.
tnk.ponder.mana_tubes_02.step_1: Place an Iron Sheet above Glass in two Mechanical Crafters. Point the upper crafter down and the lower one toward the output. The same Empty Tube is used for Mana and Spectral Ruby tubes.
tnk.ponder.mana_tubes_03.step_1: Fill each Empty Tube with 300 mB Mana.
tnk.ponder.dragon_breath.step_1: Align the Dragon Head with the fan airflow to use the Dragon Breath processing type.
tnk.ponder.dragon_breath_02.step_1: An Item Drain empties each bottle into 250 mB Dragon Breath and returns the bottle.
tnk.ponder.dragon_breath_03.step_1: Supply the Arcane line with 400 mB Dragon Breath per mechanism.
tnk.ponder.paintball_choice.step_1: Crushing a Dye Entangled Singularity produces exactly ONE paintball.
tnk.ponder.paintball_choice.step_2: The starting colour is randomly Red, Green, Yellow, Blue or Purple.
tnk.ponder.paintball_choice.step_3: The recipe viewer shows a representative colour. Sort the actual item that leaves the Wheels.
tnk.ponder.paintball_choice.header: One paintball, one randomly chosen colour
tnk.ponder.paintball_draining.step_1: Red becomes Green and releases 10 mB Uncommon Ink.
tnk.ponder.paintball_draining_02.step_1: Green becomes Yellow and releases 10 mB Uncommon Ink.
tnk.ponder.paintball_draining_03.step_1: Yellow becomes Blue and releases 10 mB Uncommon Ink.
tnk.ponder.paintball_draining_04.step_1: Blue becomes Purple and releases 10 mB Uncommon Ink. Take Purple off here if you need Chromatic Compound.
tnk.ponder.paintball_draining_05.step_1: Purple becomes Gray and releases 10 mB Uncommon Ink.
tnk.ponder.radiance_beacon.step_1: Activate the Beacon and leave a clear path for its beam.
tnk.ponder.radiance_beacon.header: Activate the Beacon and leave a clear path for its beam
tnk.ponder.radiance_beacon_02.step_1: Bring dropped Chromatic Compound into the working Beacon beam.
tnk.ponder.radiance_beacon_03.step_1: Collect Refined Radiance, press a Radiant Sheet, then use Mechanical Crafting for the Coil.
tnk.ponder.single_creation_gem.step_1: Supply an Eclipse Lens and at least 32 RPM. This recipe has a long processing cycle.
tnk.ponder.single_creation_gem.step_2: ONE input is converted when the cycle completes. The other inputs wait.
tnk.ponder.single_creation_gem.step_3: Extract the completed Gem and meter the next input into the station.
tnk.ponder.single_creation_gem.header: One Unstable Creation Gem per laser cycle
tnk.ponder.creation_return.step_1: Pass 2, station 1/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return.step_2: Pass 2, station 2/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return.step_3: Pass 2, station 3/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return_02.step_1: Pass 2, station 4/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return_02.step_2: Pass 2, station 5/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return_02.step_3: Pass 2, station 6/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return_03.step_1: Pass 2, station 7/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return_03.step_2: Pass 2, station 8/9. Each ingredient is consumed again.
tnk.ponder.creation_return_03.step_3: 18/18 operations: the final Matter Construct finishes the Creation Core.
tnk.ponder.seeded_stone_02.step_1: Compact one discovered Myalite, seven End Stone and one Amethyst Shard into eight Myalite using a Mechanical Press over a Basin.
tnk.ponder.crusher_build.step_1: Build the actual structure. Reveal the layers from the bottom upwards.
tnk.ponder.crusher_build_02.step_1: Use a Light Engineering Machine at the highlighted position. The Crusher is needed before Heavy Engineering Machines can be made.
tnk.ponder.crusher_build_02.header: Use a Light Engineering Machine at the highlighted position
tnk.ponder.crusher_build_03.step_1: Complete the structure before forming it with the Engineer's Hammer. Connect its native power and material ports.
tnk.ponder.crusher_build_03.header: Complete the structure before forming it with the Engineer's Hammer
tnk.ponder.crusher_build_04.step_1: The formed model is now shown. Follow the marked input, electrical connection and output into the operating lesson.
tnk.ponder.crusher_build_04.header: The formed model is now shown
tnk.ponder.excavator_build.step_1: Build the actual structure. Reveal the layers from the bottom upwards.
tnk.ponder.excavator_build_02.step_1: The highlighted Heavy Engineering machine block replaces a native structural component.
tnk.ponder.excavator_build_03.step_1: Complete the structure before forming it with the Engineer's Hammer. Connect its native power and material ports.
tnk.ponder.excavator_build_04.step_1: The formed model is now shown. Follow the marked input, electrical connection and output into the operating lesson.
tnk.ponder.arc_furnace_build.step_1: Build the actual structure. Reveal the layers from the bottom upwards.
tnk.ponder.arc_furnace_build_02.step_1: The highlighted Heavy Engineering machine block replaces a native structural component.
tnk.ponder.arc_furnace_build_02.header: Arc Furnace: construction and service points: Tk3 Heavy Engineering Machine (2)
tnk.ponder.arc_furnace_build_03.step_1: Complete the structure before forming it with the Engineer's Hammer. Connect its native power and material ports.
tnk.ponder.arc_furnace_build_03.header: Complete the structure before forming it with the Engineer's Hammer
tnk.ponder.arc_furnace_build_04.step_1: The formed model is now shown. Follow the marked input, electrical connection and output into the operating lesson.
tnk.ponder.arc_furnace_build_04.header: The formed model is now shown
tnk.ponder.calculation_mechanism.step_3: The Certus Wrench is retained and loses one durability.
tnk.ponder.calculation_mechanism.step_4: Press the same workpiece to finish the assembly.
tnk.ponder.overcharge_alloy.step_1: Fill Chromatic Compound with 250 mB of HEALING II potion.
tnk.ponder.overcharge_alloy_02.step_1: The Arc Furnace uses Compound Base, two Lapis and Coke Dust for Lapis Alloy.
tnk.ponder.overcharge_alloy_03.step_1: Charge the Alloy with electrical power.
tnk.ponder.overcharge_alloy_04.step_1: Apply 250 mB of normal Swiftness potion.
tnk.ponder.overcharge_alloy_05.step_1: Press the same workpiece TWICE to finish the Overcharge Sheet.
tnk.ponder.stargaze_alloy.step_1: Apply a Conduit to Compound Base.
tnk.ponder.stargaze_alloy.step_3: Add 250 mB Chocolate to finish the Alloy.
tnk.ponder.stargaze_alloy.step_4: Press the Alloy FIVE times to complete the sheet.
tnk.ponder.stargaze_alloy.header: Stargaze Alloy and five pressing operations
tnk.ponder.unstable_core.step_2: Apply the Overcharge Sheet to the same workpiece.
tnk.ponder.unstable_core.step_3: Apply the Boot Drive. This tool stays in the hand and is reused.
tnk.ponder.unstable_core_02.step_2: Fill with 500 mB Mana to finish the Unstable Creation Core.
tnk.ponder.renewable_biodiesel.step_1: Compatible seeds and crops yield the canonical CDG Plant Oil through compacting.
tnk.ponder.renewable_biodiesel_02.step_1: Use a supported biomass recipe in the CDG fermentation process.
tnk.ponder.renewable_biodiesel_03.step_1: Mix Plant Oil and Ethanol using the installed CDG Biodiesel recipe.
tnk.ponder.biodiesel_power.step_1: Buffer Biodiesel in a tank and pump it to the generator's fluid input.
tnk.ponder.biodiesel_power.header: Supplying a generator with canonical fuel: Biodiesel Bucket (1)
tnk.ponder.biodiesel_power_02.step_1: A supported generator converts the fuel into power for the next part of your factory.
tnk.ponder.biodiesel_power_02.step_2: C&A Bioethanol is a separate superheating fuel. Do not mix it into the CDG Ethanol supply.
tnk.ponder.amethyst_growth.step_1: Amethyst stage 1/3: three separate 100 mB Water pours advance this visible growth stage.
tnk.ponder.amethyst_growth_02.step_1: Amethyst stage 2/3: three separate 100 mB Water pours advance this visible growth stage.
tnk.ponder.amethyst_growth_03.step_1: Amethyst stage 3/3: three separate 100 mB Water pours advance this visible growth stage.
tnk.ponder.sealed_mechanism.step_4: Press the same workpiece to finish the assembly.
tnk.ponder.reinforced_mechanism.step_4: Press the same workpiece to finish the assembly.
tnk.ponder.industrial_electronics.step_1: Apply TWO IE Electron Tubes to Cured Rubber.
tnk.ponder.industrial_electronics.step_3: Press to finish the Advanced Electronic Component. Feed it to the next assembly.
tnk.ponder.industrial_electronics_02.ste: The Industrial assembly starts from Reinforced Mechanism. Apply Steel Plate.
Apply the Advanced Electronic Component made by the first three stations.
tnk.ponder.industrial_electronics_03.ste: The Screwdriver stays in the Deployer and loses one durability.
Press the same workpiece to finish the Industrial Mechanism.
tnk.ponder.arcane_mechanism.step_1: Start with Industrial Mechanism and add 400 mB Dragon Breath.
tnk.ponder.arcane_mechanism.step_4: Apply a Mana Tube to finish. No extra Press is needed.
tnk.ponder.arcane_mechanism.header: A mixed fluid and item Arcane assembly
tnk.ponder.shadow_spectral.step_1: A Convergence Lens converts Chromatic Compound to Shadow Steel.
tnk.ponder.shadow_spectral_02.step_1: Heat Shadow Steel with a Sea Lantern to make Refined Shadow Alloy.
tnk.ponder.shadow_spectral_03.step_1: Polish Spectral Ruby, then deploy it onto the shared Empty Tube.
tnk.ponder.shadow_spectral_03.header: Deploying: Polished Spectral Ruby Electron Tube
tnk.ponder.eclipse_mechanism.step_1: Start with Arcane Mechanism and apply TWO Radiant Coils.
tnk.ponder.eclipse_mechanism.step_3: Apply the Polished Spectral Ruby Electron Tube.
tnk.ponder.eclipse_mechanism_02.step_2: A final Press finishes the Eclipse Mechanism.
tnk.ponder.excavator_survey.step_1: Hold use on a valid natural surface to survey. Move at least four blocks between readings; successive readings add direction and distance hints.
tnk.ponder.excavator_survey_02.step_1: Supply FE to a Core Sample Drill and right-click it to start. The drill samples the ground at this position.
tnk.ponder.excavator_survey_02.header: Core Sample Drill: power and start
tnk.ponder.excavator_survey_03.step_1: Collect the Core Sample and inspect its mineral information. Place it for its visible sample and readout.
tnk.ponder.excavator_survey_03.header: Reading and placing a Core Sample
tnk.ponder.excavator_survey_04.step_1: F3+G helps track chunk boundaries while comparing positions. Modern IE veins cover an area; a chunk border is not a promise of a separate ore deposit.
tnk.ponder.excavator_operation.step_1: This is the formed Excavator with its separately formed Bucket Wheel. The wheel is positioned using the native IE assembly alignment.
tnk.ponder.excavator_operation_02.step_1: Connect FE to the marked electrical input. The rotating wheel extracts the surveyed deposit; the conveyor carries material to the rear output.
tnk.ponder.excavator_operation_03.step_1: Sort the extracted materials into their appropriate processing branches.
tnk.ponder.coke_creosote.step_1: The Charcoal route uses eight Charcoal for one Coke and 500 mB Creosote.
tnk.ponder.coke_creosote_02.step_1: Buffer Creosote and use it for Treated Wood.
tnk.ponder.coke_creosote_03.step_1: Use the retained native blast-furnace steel routes and their actual fuels.
tnk.ponder.ore_stone_yields.step_1: Milling Veridium produces its primary Crushed Copper output.
tnk.ponder.ore_stone_yields_02.step_1: Crushing the raw stone also gives its configured nugget bonus and an XP chance.
tnk.ponder.ore_stone_yields_02.step_2: Ochrum, Asurine and Crimsite supply their corresponding metals.
tnk.ponder.quartz_iron_fans.step_1: Haunt Sand with Soul Fire airflow to make Soul Sand.
tnk.ponder.quartz_iron_fans_02.step_1: Wash Soul Sand for Quartz. Extra Quartz outputs are chance rolls.
tnk.ponder.quartz_iron_fans_03.step_1: Washing Gravel yields Crushed Iron, with a possible second output.
tnk.ponder.early_clay_02.step_1: Mill the Gravel again to obtain Sand.
tnk.ponder.early_clay_03.step_1: Wash the Sand. Each of three Clay Ball rolls has a 33% chance.
tnk.ponder.early_clay_04.step_1: Unheated mixing uses one Andesite and one Clay Ball for one Alloy.
tnk.ponder.linked_storage.step_1: The retained dye-channel recipes configure the Linked Chest's channel colour.
tnk.ponder.linked_storage_02.step_1: Matching endpoints share their linked inventory. Feed one endpoint and extract from the other.
tnk.ponder.linked_storage_03.step_1: A linked Pouch provides portable access. Use the native binding and recolouring actions.
tnk.ponder.pretty_requests.step_1: Connect a source chest and the Item Terminal with pipes.
tnk.ponder.pretty_requests_02.step_1: Extraction modules move items out of their connected source inventory.
tnk.ponder.pretty_requests_03.step_1: Use the terminal to request stored items. Give requested items a reachable destination.
tnk.ponder.pretty_crafting.step_1: Configure a Crafting Module beside a real crafting inventory or processing buffer.
tnk.ponder.pretty_crafting_02.step_1: The connected machine performs the recipe. The network must be able to supply all required inputs.
tnk.ponder.pretty_crafting_03.step_1: Make the result available to the pipe network and keep it separate from unwanted input circulation.
tnk.ponder.storage_controller.step_1: Connect compatible storage to a Storage Controller. It gives the bank a shared access point.
tnk.ponder.storage_controller.header: Connect compatible storage to a Storage Controller
tnk.ponder.storage_controller_02.step_1: Feed the verified access inventory from your Create line.
tnk.ponder.storage_controller_02.header: Feed the verified access inventory from your Create line
tnk.ponder.storage_controller_03.step_1: Use a separate extraction side and a filter for the materials that leave the bank.
tnk.ponder.storage_controller_03.header: A Sophisticated Storage bank for your factory: Iron Ingot (3)
tnk.ponder.storage_filters.step_1: Define which items the endpoint accepts before connecting a mixed-output factory.
tnk.ponder.storage_filters.header: Filtering and compacting at a storage endpoint: Filter Upgrade (1)
tnk.ponder.storage_filters_02.step_1: A Compacting Upgrade can convert eligible groups into their packed forms.
tnk.ponder.storage_filters_02.header: Filtering and compacting at a storage endpoint: Iron Ingot (2)
tnk.ponder.storage_filters_03.step_1: Match the output filter to the form you actually need. Packed blocks and loose ingredients are different requests.
tnk.ponder.storage_filters_03.header: Match the output filter to the form you actually need
tnk.ponder.ars_source.step_1: An Agronomic Sourcelink converts nearby crop growth into Source.
tnk.ponder.ars_source.header: An Agronomic Sourcelink converts nearby crop growth into Source
tnk.ponder.ars_source_02.step_1: Collect that Source in a nearby Source Jar. Keep the generator and destination within their native reach.
tnk.ponder.ars_source_02.header: Collect that Source in a nearby Source Jar
tnk.ponder.ars_source_03.step_1: The Source buffer supplies compatible Ars processes, including Source-assisted imbuement.
tnk.ponder.ars_source_03.header: Supplying an Ars Source Jar: Imbuement Chamber (3)
tnk.ponder.ars_imbuement.step_1: Place the Imbuement Chamber beside its Source supply and leave room for item handling.
tnk.ponder.ars_imbuement.header: Imbuement and a Source Gem supply: Imbuement Chamber (1)
tnk.ponder.ars_imbuement_02.step_1: Use the native Source Gem Block imbuement route with its listed Source requirement.
tnk.ponder.ars_imbuement_02.header: Imbuement and a Source Gem supply: Amethyst Block (2)
tnk.ponder.ars_imbuement_03.step_1: Unpack the Source Gem Block into four Source Gems for your Arcane production.
tnk.ponder.ars_imbuement_03.header: Imbuement and a Source Gem supply: Source Gem Block (3)
tnk.ponder.ars_apparatus.step_1: Put the Enchanting Apparatus on its Arcane Core.
tnk.ponder.ars_apparatus.header: Put the Enchanting Apparatus on its Arcane Core
tnk.ponder.ars_apparatus_02.step_1: Arrange the recipe's pedestal ingredients around it and keep Source available.
tnk.ponder.ars_apparatus_02.header: Arranging the Enchanting Apparatus: Arcane Pedestal (2)
tnk.ponder.ars_apparatus_03.step_1: Use the recipe's main item on the Apparatus to start the operation. Collect the result from the apparatus.
tnk.ponder.ars_apparatus_03.header: Use the recipe's main item on the Apparatus to start the operation
tnk.ponder.witchery_altar.step_1: Place six Altar blocks in a 3 by 2 rectangle, one block high, to form the Altar.
tnk.ponder.witchery_altar.header: A Witchery altar work area: Deepslate Altar Block (1)
tnk.ponder.witchery_altar_02.step_1: Surround the work area with living vegetation and the native power-supporting blocks.
tnk.ponder.witchery_altar_02.header: A Witchery altar work area: Oak Sapling (2)
tnk.ponder.witchery_altar_03.step_1: Read the altar's actual available power before starting a nearby working.
tnk.ponder.witchery_altar_03.header: A Witchery altar work area: Altar (3)
tnk.ponder.witchery_circle.step_1: Draw this seven-block-wide circle in Ritual Chalk, with Golden Ritual Chalk at the centre.
tnk.ponder.witchery_circle.header: The Rite of Daytime circle: Ritual Chalk (1)
tnk.ponder.witchery_circle_02.step_1: The Rite of Daytime consumes one Clock and one Glowstone Dust.
tnk.ponder.witchery_circle_02.header: The Rite of Daytime consumes one Clock and one Glowstone Dust
tnk.ponder.witchery_circle_03.step_1: The nearby Altar must supply 3,000 power. Activate the Golden centre to advance to the next day.
tnk.ponder.witchery_circle_03.header: The nearby Altar must supply 3,000 power
tnk.ponder.crop_contraption.step_1: Prepare a small crop strip, then test harvesting before extending the farm.
tnk.ponder.crop_contraption.header: Crop farm: prepare the crop strip
tnk.ponder.crop_contraption_02.step_1: Attach the Harvester facing the crop row, on the moving contraption.
tnk.ponder.crop_contraption_03.step_1: Collect the produce and preserve the seed supply. Add compatible modded crops only after checking their harvest behavior.
tnk.ponder.cooking_factory.step_1: Give the Cooking Pot a valid heat source and a reliable ingredient supply.
tnk.ponder.cooking_factory.header: A Cooking Pot endpoint in a Create kitchen: Cooking Pot (1)
tnk.ponder.cooking_factory_02.step_1: Feed the ingredients of one actual Cooking Pot recipe. Keep unrelated farm output out of the input.
tnk.ponder.cooking_factory_02.header: Feed the ingredients of one actual Cooking Pot recipe
tnk.ponder.cooking_factory_03.step_1: Provide any required meal containers and collect the finished food into an output buffer.
tnk.ponder.cooking_factory_03.header: A Cooking Pot endpoint in a Create kitchen: Bowl (3)
tnk.ponder.enchanting_shelves.step_1: Start with an accessible enchanting table and a clear one-block gap to the shelves.
tnk.ponder.enchanting_shelves.header: A clear shelf arrangement around an enchanting table: Enchanting Table (1)
tnk.ponder.enchanting_shelves_02.step_1: Place the valid shelves around the table. Keep the gap free of obstructions.
tnk.ponder.enchanting_shelves_02.header: Place the valid shelves around the table
tnk.ponder.enchanting_shelves_03.step_1: Inspect the displayed enchanting stats. Different Apothic shelves change the available stat combination.
tnk.ponder.electrical_motor.step_1: An Alternator converts supplied rotational power into electrical power.
tnk.ponder.electrical_motor_02.step_1: Connect the electrical source to the compatible motor connection.
tnk.ponder.electrical_motor_03.step_1: An Electric Motor drives the shaft network when supplied with electrical power.
tnk.ponder.building_minerals.step_1: Compact Calcite, Clay and Water into batches of RU Chalk.
tnk.ponder.building_minerals_02.step_1: Heated Calcite and Clay processing makes Marlstone.
tnk.ponder.building_minerals_03.step_1: Slate uses Deepslate, Flint and Lava. Check the complete current batch in JEI.
tnk.ponder.angel_ring_wings.step_1: Build the exact 11 by 7 wing pattern. The Diamond Ring is the central recipe ingredient.
tnk.ponder.angel_ring_wings_02.step_1: Route every occupied Crafter towards the final ejection point. Cover the required empty recipe positions.
tnk.ponder.angel_ring_wings_03.step_1: Supply all forty ingredients, then trigger the complete crafting assembly.
tnk.ponder.magnetic_quarry.step_1: Use the native Magnetic Quarry build and magnetic controls from the current cave guide.
tnk.ponder.magnetic_quarry.header: Connecting the Magnetic Quarry to your ore line: Quarry (1)
tnk.ponder.magnetic_quarry_02.step_1: The construction integration uses Create Drill parts in this quarry's supply chain.
tnk.ponder.magnetic_quarry_02.header: Connecting the Magnetic Quarry to your ore line: Mechanical Drill (2)
tnk.ponder.magnetic_quarry_03.step_1: Collect the extracted materials into a buffer and route supported raw metals into the ordinary processing line.
tnk.ponder.scroll_school.step_1: Put Paper below the Deployer and supply a valid school Focus. Blaze Rod is a native Fire Focus.
tnk.ponder.scroll_school_02.step_1: Use an ALLOW-LIST Filter containing BOTH the held Focus and the chosen Unfinished school Scroll.
tnk.ponder.scroll_school_03.step_1: Enable Respect Data. The held-item entry allows automatic hand restocking.
tnk.ponder.scroll_binding.step_1: Feed the unfinished school Scroll to a second Deployer holding the required Ink.
tnk.ponder.scroll_binding_02.step_1: Its allow-list Filter contains the Ink AND ONE exact completed spell-and-level Scroll.
tnk.ponder.scroll_binding_03.step_1: Enable Respect Data and keep the exact spell components on the result filter.
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace.step_1: Place eight Nuclear Furnace Components as a 2 by 2 by 2 cube. Placing the last component forms the actual Nuclear Furnace.
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace.header: Place eight Nuclear Furnace Components as a 2 by 2 by 2 cube
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace_02.step_1: Supply the furnace with its native nuclear fuel and cooking input. The exhaust and furnace model are now active.
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace_02.header: Supply the furnace with its native nuclear fuel and cooking input
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace_03.step_1: Feed Raw Iron as the cooking input. Nuclear fuel supplies the heat, and Iron Ingots leave through the bottom output.
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace_03.header: Feed Raw Iron as the cooking input
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace_04.step_1: When dedicated recipes are enabled, special routes include Coal Block to nine Coke and Smooth Quartz to four Nether Quartz. Check JEI.
tnk.ponder.nuclear_furnace_04.header: The Nuclear Furnace and special recipes: Smooth Quartz (4)
tnk.ponder.xp_factory.step_1: Crushing lines produce XP Nuggets as occasional byproducts. Sort and buffer them.
tnk.ponder.xp_factory.step_2: Use Enchantment Industry's native grinding, disenchanting and XP-collection equipment.
tnk.ponder.xp_factory.step_3: Fill each bottle with 10 mB Liquid Experience. Keep this XP-fluid output separate from Mana and Uncommon Ink.
tnk.ponder.xp_factory.header: Connecting Liquid XP production to factories
tnk.ponder.aquatic_prismarine.step_1: Pump Water into the bottom of the Conduit Cage to awaken it.
tnk.ponder.aquatic_prismarine_02.step_1: The Fan blows through the awakened Cage toward the Depot, producing a Channeling stream.
tnk.ponder.aquatic_prismarine_03.step_1: Combine the prismarine materials for Sea Lanterns used in Refined Shadow Alloy production.
tnk.ponder.aquatic_prismarine_03.header: Channeling with a compact Conduit Cage: Prismarine Crystals (3)
tnk.ponder.trading_floor.step_1: Use the Trading Floor station's native villager and trade setup.
tnk.ponder.trading_floor.header: Use the Trading Floor station's native villager and trade setup
tnk.ponder.trading_floor_02.step_1: Supply only the input of the selected available trade, with space reserved for its output.
tnk.ponder.trading_floor_02.header: A trading endpoint with input and output buffers: Wheat (2)
tnk.ponder.trading_floor_03.step_1: Export the result into storage and allow the villager's native restocking rules to apply.
tnk.ponder.trading_floor_03.header: A trading endpoint with input and output buffers: Emerald (3)
tnk.ponder.laser_setup.step_1: Place the emitter above a Depot or horizontal belt, with one air block between them.
tnk.ponder.laser_setup_02.step_1: Connect rotational power to either exposed end of its horizontal axle.
tnk.ponder.laser_setup_03.step_1: Supply and extract items at the Depot, or let the belt carry them through.
tnk.ponder.laser_power.step_1: The ordinary minimum is 16 RPM. A specific recipe can require a higher speed.
tnk.ponder.laser_power_02.step_1: Recipe durations are measured at 32 RPM. More speed shortens processing up to the configured cap.
tnk.ponder.laser_power_03.step_1: The connected emitter draws stress. Leave capacity for it in the kinetic network.
tnk.ponder.laser_processing.step_1: A matching ordinary recipe can process complete recipe quantities together in one cycle.
tnk.ponder.laser_processing_02.step_1: Input is consumed when the cycle completes. Incomplete recipe quantities stay behind.
tnk.ponder.laser_processing_03.step_1: The Unstable Creation Gem is the exception: one input per completed cycle.
tnk.ponder.laser_lenses.step_1: Right-click with a lens to install it or exchange the current lens.
tnk.ponder.laser_lenses_02.step_1: The lens selects matching recipes and the beam colour. Lenses are reusable.
tnk.ponder.laser_lenses_03.step_1: Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to remove the lens. Item-handler automation can move lenses too.
tnk.ponder.laser_chains.step_1: Growth starts the Certus crystal chain. Finish growth using the Water Spout stages.
tnk.ponder.laser_chains.step_2: Convergence turns Wart-derived Cinder Flour into Silver Dust.
tnk.ponder.laser_chains.step_3: Eclipse finishes the industrial metal chain: four Dust to five Ingots.
tnk.ponder.laser_redstone.step_1: Without a redstone signal, a matching powered emitter runs automatically.
tnk.ponder.laser_redstone_02.step_1: A powered redstone signal disables the emitter and releases an interrupted belt item.
tnk.ponder.laser_redstone_03.step_1: Remove the signal to allow a new cycle. An interrupted cycle leaves its input unchanged.
tnk.ponder.amethyst_start.step_1: A Growth Lens turns one Amethyst Shard into a Small Amethyst Bud. Send it into the Water-spouting loop.
tnk.ponder.workshop_pencil.step_1: Right-click the first corner with the Measuring Pencil.
tnk.ponder.workshop_pencil_02.step_1: Right-click the opposite corner. The measurement includes both end blocks; the readout also gives the straight-line distance.
tnk.ponder.workshop_pencil_03.step_1: Sneak-right-click to clear the measurement and start another build.
tnk.ponder.workshop_satchel.step_1: Right-click the Builder's Satchel to open its 27 building-block slots.
tnk.ponder.workshop_satchel_02.step_1: With held-block refill enabled, matching blocks move from the Satchel back into your depleted held stack.
tnk.ponder.workshop_satchel_03.step_1: Refill uses the real blocks stored inside. Restock the Satchel when those blocks run out.
tnk.ponder.workshop_brush.step_1: Use the Brush in air, or sneak-right-click, to configure its palette. Choose up to nine materials and their weights.
tnk.ponder.workshop_brush_02.step_1: Right-click the build surface to place a weighted mix. The Brush consumes actual available building blocks.
tnk.ponder.workshop_brush_03.step_1: Keep the selected materials supplied. Disabled or unavailable materials are not free substitutes.
tnk.ponder.workshop_mob_cage.step_1: Right-click an eligible mob with an empty Mob Cage. The captured mob is saved inside the item.
tnk.ponder.workshop_mob_cage_02.step_1: Right-click a block to release it at the new position. The Mob Cage becomes empty and can be used again.
tnk.ponder.workshop_mob_cage_03.step_1: Bosses are excluded. Dismount and remove leads before capturing a mob.
tnk.ponder.workshop_spawner_cage.step_1: Right-click the spawner with an empty Spawner Cage. The original block is captured with its saved spawner data.
tnk.ponder.workshop_spawner_cage_02.step: Right-click the destination block to place the captured spawner. The filled Cage is consumed.
tnk.ponder.workshop_spawner_cage_02.head: Spawner Cage: place the stored spawner
tnk.ponder.workshop_spawner_cage_03.step: Inspect the spawner tooltip for its mob, activation range, spawn count and delay. Moving it preserves its rules.
tnk.ponder.workshop_spawner_cage_03.head: Spawner Cage: retained spawner data
tnk.ponder.workshop_magic_mirror.step_1: Stand at the desired waypoint and sneak-right-click to bind this Mirror.
tnk.ponder.workshop_magic_mirror.header: Magic Mirror: bind a return point
tnk.ponder.workshop_magic_mirror_02.step: At another location, hold right-click for two seconds. The Magic Mirror returns its user to the bound waypoint.
tnk.ponder.workshop_magic_mirror_02.head: Magic Mirror: return travel
tnk.ponder.workshop_magic_mirror_03.step: Keep a safe landing area. The single-target Mirror requires you to dismount before travel.
tnk.ponder.workshop_magic_mirror_03.head: Mirrors: safe return positions
tnk.ponder.workshop_chorus_mirror.step_1: Sneak-right-click to bind the destination, then gather the group within five blocks of the user.
tnk.ponder.workshop_chorus_mirror.header: Chorus Mirror: bind the group destination
tnk.ponder.workshop_chorus_mirror_02.ste: Hold right-click for two seconds. Nearby entities, items and riding groups travel with the user.
tnk.ponder.workshop_chorus_mirror_03.ste: Leave enough safe room at the waypoint for the whole group. An unsafe destination prevents the trip.
tnk.ponder.workshop_projector.step_1: Place the Quest Projector and right-click to configure it. This preview uses its real Text projection mode.
tnk.ponder.workshop_projector_02.step_1: Adjust width, elevation, facing and colours. Keep the projection readable from the intended viewing position.
tnk.ponder.workshop_projector_03.step_1: The Quests mode can display up to five selected FTB quests and their tasks. Images use direct image links.
tnk.ponder.workshop_projector_03.header: Quest Projector: task and image modes
tnk.ponder.workshop_area.step_1: Configure the Projector's area title, subtitle and trigger radii around your workshop.
tnk.ponder.workshop_area_02.step_1: Entering the area can show its title. Keep the inner and outer radii distinct to avoid repeated boundary triggers.
tnk.ponder.workshop_community.step_1: Open the Community Board to inspect the active challenge, shared goal and your personal reward requirements.
tnk.ponder.workshop_community_02.step_1: For delivery challenges, use Deliver Items in the board interface. Matching plain items are consumed and credited to the contributor.
tnk.ponder.workshop_community_03.step_1: The shared total and your own contribution are separate. Claim earned reward tiers from My Rewards.
tnk.ponder.workshop_trading_hub.step_1: Place and use the Trading Hub to open the Workshop trading destinations.
tnk.ponder.workshop_trading_hub_02.step_: Use Trading Hub - Personal and Trading Hub - Shops to find the appropriate saved destination.
tnk.ponder.workshop_trading_hub_03.step_: Select a destination and use its teleport action. Entries and access follow the server's actual trading setup.
tnk.ponder.print_silicon.step_1: The Deployer applies the matching die. The die stays in its hand.
tnk.ponder.print_silicon.step_2: The Mechanical Press finishes this printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.print_logic.step_1: The Deployer applies the matching die. The die stays in its hand.
tnk.ponder.print_logic.step_2: The Mechanical Press finishes this printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.print_calculation.step_1: The Deployer applies the matching die. The die stays in its hand.
tnk.ponder.print_calculation.step_2: The Mechanical Press finishes this printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.print_engineering.step_1: The Deployer applies the matching die. The die stays in its hand.
tnk.ponder.print_engineering.step_2: The Mechanical Press finishes this printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.print_concurrent.step_1: The Deployer applies the matching die. The die stays in its hand.
tnk.ponder.print_concurrent.step_2: The Mechanical Press finishes this printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.processor_logic.step_1: Add Redstone to the printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.processor_logic.step_2: Add Printed Silicon, then send the same workpiece to the Press.
tnk.ponder.processor_logic.step_3: One pressing operation finishes this Processor.
tnk.ponder.processor_calculation.step_1: Add Redstone to the printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.processor_calculation.step_2: Add Printed Silicon, then send the same workpiece to the Press.
tnk.ponder.processor_calculation.step_3: One pressing operation finishes this Processor.
tnk.ponder.processor_engineering.step_1: Add Redstone to the printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.processor_engineering.step_2: Add Printed Silicon, then send the same workpiece to the Press.
tnk.ponder.processor_engineering.step_3: One pressing operation finishes this Processor.
tnk.ponder.processor_concurrent.step_1: Add Redstone to the printed circuit.
tnk.ponder.processor_concurrent.step_2: Add Printed Silicon, then send the same workpiece to the Press.
tnk.ponder.processor_concurrent.step_3: One pressing operation finishes this Processor.
tnk.ponder.copy_silicon_die.step_1: Apply the original die to an Iron Block. Keep the original in the Deployer.
tnk.ponder.copy_silicon_die.step_2: Press the copy into a second reusable die.
tnk.ponder.copy_logic_die.step_1: Apply the original die to an Iron Block. Keep the original in the Deployer.
tnk.ponder.copy_logic_die.step_2: Press the copy into a second reusable die.
tnk.ponder.copy_calculation_die.step_1: Apply the original die to an Iron Block. Keep the original in the Deployer.
tnk.ponder.copy_calculation_die.step_2: Press the copy into a second reusable die.
tnk.ponder.copy_engineering_die.step_1: Apply the original die to an Iron Block. Keep the original in the Deployer.
tnk.ponder.copy_engineering_die.step_2: Press the copy into a second reusable die.
tnk.ponder.infinity_insert.step_1: Insert the resource-specific Infinity Cell into the powered ME Drive. It supplies its named resource.
tnk.ponder.infinity_power.step_1: Supply FE through the Energy Acceptor. The Drive and its cell still need network power.
tnk.ponder.infinity_export.step_1: Configure the Export Bus with the cell resource. It supplies the adjacent inventory.
tnk.ponder.infinity_downstream.step_1: A Veridium Cell supplies Veridium, not Copper. Keep the downstream milling or crushing factory.
tnk.ponder.me_storage.step_1: An Energy Acceptor, connected Drive and storage cell form the storage side of this small network.
tnk.ponder.me_import.step_1: Point an Import Bus at the output inventory to bring completed products back into storage.
tnk.ponder.me_pattern.step_1: A Pattern Provider sends the encoded ingredients into the adjacent machine input inventory.
tnk.ponder.me_proxy.step_1: Connect the ME Proxy to the network. A filtered Create Funnel can pull the selected network item.
tnk.ponder.me_energy_provider.step_1: Mount the Energy Provider on an Energy Acceptor. Connect rotation to its exposed shaft.
tnk.ponder.me_energy_provider.header: Kinetic power for the ME network
tnk.ponder.creation_ore_setup.step_1: Place the Creation Ore Catalyst beneath the Lava source. Keep the Chute beneath the generated ore.
tnk.ponder.creation_ore_position.step_1: The generator position selects a stable weighted ore result. Moving the generator can change its ore.
tnk.ponder.creation_ore_position.header: Creation ore generator: choosing an output
tnk.ponder.eternal_equipment.step_1: Use one Creation Core on eligible durable equipment: 256 RPM for 120 seconds. The Core is consumed.
tnk.ponder.eternal_components.step_1: The Eternal upgrade keeps the same item, enchantments, name and affixes, and adds Unbreakable.
tnk.ponder.eternal_exclusions.step_1: Already-unbreakable items are excluded. Construction Sticks use their separate native unbreakable upgrade.
tnk.ponder.creation_crafting_ore_generat: Build this 5 by 5 Mechanical Crafter array. Follow JEI for its ingredients; route the arrows toward the bottom output.
tnk.ponder.creation_crafting_sigil_of_as: Build this 5 by 5 Mechanical Crafter array. Follow JEI for its ingredients; route the arrows toward the bottom output.
tnk.ponder.creation_crafting_creative_bl: Build this 7 by 7 Mechanical Crafter array. Follow JEI for its ingredients; route the arrows toward the bottom output.
tnk.ponder.creation_crafting_creative_bo: Build this 7 by 7 Mechanical Crafter array. Follow JEI for its ingredients; route the arrows toward the bottom output.
tnk.ponder.trophy_operations_5.step_1: Press the workpiece, then repeat the full sequence until all 64 cycles are complete.
tnk.ponder.trophy_cycle.step_1: One cycle deploys five Creation Machines and the seven other ingredients, then presses the workpiece.
tnk.ponder.trophy_repeats.step_1: Repeat all twelve operations 64 times. Totals include 320 Creation Machines and 64 of each other deployed ingredient.
tnk.ponder.mega_torch.step_1: The beta radius is 64 blocks in each direction. This small platform is a diagram of the protected area.
tnk.ponder.mega_existing.step_1: The Mega Torch prevents new natural hostile spawns. It does not remove mobs that are already here.
tnk.ponder.mega_spawners.step_1: This beta blocks only natural spawns. Normal mob spawners still operate inside its area.
tnk.ponder.dread_lamp.step_1: The Dread Lamp blocks natural passive spawning in its configured 64-block radius. It does not erase existing animals.
tnk.ponder.feral_light.step_1: The lantern places invisible lights within 16 blocks. It targets light level 10 in this beta.
tnk.ponder.frozen_pearl.step_1: After removing a Feral Flare Lantern, use the Frozen Pearl to clear its residual invisible lights.
tnk.ponder.selling_insert.step_1: Open the Selling Bin and deposit eligible goods. The configured sellable list determines what can be sold.
tnk.ponder.selling_payment.step_1: Collect the resulting currency from the bin. Currency and prices come from the active Selling Bin datapacks.
tnk.ponder.boss_rematch.step_1: Supported defeated bosses can leave a respawn cage at their recorded home or death site. Keep that area accessible.
tnk.ponder.boss_payment.step_1: Use Boss Respawn Tokens from quests, the Market or events. Jade shows the required amount. Cataclysm keeps its own altar items.
tnk.ponder.starcatcher_tackle.step_1: Open a Tackle Box. Put the rod in its rod slot and fit a bobber, bait and hook in their matching slots.
tnk.ponder.starcatcher_guide.step_1: Check the guide for each fish habitat and conditions. One fishing spot cannot provide every species.
tnk.ponder.flow_gate.step_1: Right-click the Stillwater Anchor to choose its radius. It calms connected water; power it with redstone to pause it.
tnk.ponder.flow_generator.step_1: Supply rotation through the bottom shaft. RPM controls strength; reversing rotation reverses the current.
tnk.ponder.infinity_crafting_4.step_1: Craft four matching resource samples with two Quartz Glass, an empty Cell Housing, cell component 1k and calculation mechanism. Filled storage cells are not consumed.
tnk.ponder.infinity_crafting_5.step_1: Craft four matching resource samples with two Quartz Glass, an empty Cell Housing, cell component 4k and reinforced mechanism. Filled storage cells are not consumed.
tnk.ponder.infinity_crafting_6.step_1: Craft four matching resource samples with two Quartz Glass, an empty Cell Housing, cell component 16k and industrial mechanism. Filled storage cells are not consumed.
tnk.ponder.infinity_creation_crafting.st: Creation cells use four matching samples, two Quartz Glass, an empty Cell Housing, a 64k component and one consumed Creation Core.
tnk.ponder.builder_wand_smithing.step_1: At a Smithing Table, combine the Master Builder Template, Diamond Construction Stick and Netherite Block. The template is consumed.
tnk.ponder.builder_unbreakable.step_1: Apply the Unbreakable Template to the stick with Crying Obsidian in a Smithing Table. This native upgrade replaces the Eternal laser route for Construction Sticks.
tnk.ponder.builder_template.step_1: Craft the Master Builder Template from four Eclipse Mechanisms, two Singularities, one Netherite Block and two Creation Cores. Use the template in the smithing upgrade.
tnk.ponder.seeded_stone_02.step_2: Return one Myalite to the next batch. Send the other seven to your building supply.
